open_questions: TESL: confirm whether it is spoken as a word or spelled out. Falls in run 2; not blocking run 1.

resolved_questions.question: Read the Nishimura Japanese code-switching passage aloud, or describe it instead?
resolved_questions.statement: I've tested Japanese, and it's a little English accented (and Kyoto accented), but it's fine.
resolved_questions.outcome: Read aloud as drafted, with each gloss following. Brett tested the voice on Japanese himself and accepts the accent.
resolved_questions.note: Accent accepted in advance, so an English- or Kyoto-accented rendering in the take is not a defect and must not be spent on as a repair.

resolved_questions.question: Does the New International Version passage in Judges carry an audio right?
resolved_questions.statement: The shibboleth box is fair dealing because of the limited size.
resolved_questions.outcome: Record and publish as drafted. Brett judges the excerpt fair dealing on length grounds.
resolved_questions.note: Brett's call as author and rights-holder of the book; not re-adjudicated here.

delivery.format: MP3 44.1 kHz 192 kbps mono, matching Chapter 1
delivery.identification_note: Export order is NOT generation order. Files were matched to segments by local Whisper transcription; the file whose timestamp fell at X01 was SH01.
delivery.wav_note: WAV is downloadable, 48 kHz 16-bit PCM, a separate render from the 44.1 kHz MP3 rather than a conversion. Re-pull as WAV if a lossless master is wanted.
delivery.defect_cause: Probable: the production loop reloaded the page about 10 seconds after clicking Generate, which cut off renders still in progress. Longer inputs are over-represented among the failures. This was an agent process error, not a script or content fault.
outstanding: X01 truncated at 50.9s of ~96s; 1,339 credits; deferred to 2026-10-01

completeness.method: characters per second of audio; the 30 sound takes cluster at 12.9-15.4, truncated ones run 16.2-26.3

repair_verification.method: each file transcribed locally with whisper small.en, identified against the exact submitted inputs, then checked that the transcript reaches the script's final words and that chars/second sits in the healthy band

partial_release.statement: publish what's available with a note that it's not done
partial_release.handling: Audio runs from the chapter opening to the end of the model of grammaticality. A spoken note stands where X01 belongs. The page and text transcript carry every unrecorded passage in full, marked where it belongs, so the written side is complete.
partial_release.loudness: normalised to -24.5 LUFS with a -1.5 dBTP ceiling, matching the Chapter 1 master
